allowed.name: zesu_lia_linear_first3
allowed.reason: The micromega leaf itself. Only BoundedSolve calls it; the check refuses its name everywhere else.

allowed.name: zesu_saturate_derived_facts
allowed.reason: The derived-facts saturation's only entry point: it runs the seminaive engine through BoundedSolve.zesu_bounded_saturate.

allowed.name: zesu_saturate_frozen_derived_facts
allowed.reason: The frozen copy of the saturation, run through BoundedSolve.zesu_bounded_saturate.

allowed.name: zesu_vm_compute_closed
allowed.reason: Refuses a goal with a local name or an unresolved evar before the VM runs, so the goal is closed and reads no fact. VmClosed loads before BoundedSolve (SearchBudget requires it).

allowed.name: zesu_finish_pointer_alignment
allowed.reason: `clear -Halign` leaves only the alignment fact before bv_simplify_arith runs on it.

allowed.name: zesu_residual_search
allowed.reason: The residual tier's depth-2 eauto over its own database (the zesu_residual hint database is defined in ResidualLemmas, after BoundedSolve). Only zesu_residual_lemma calls it, through BoundedSolve.zesu_bounded_search (pruned, then whole context, within the search budget).
